caveats: Small paired pilot, not a statistical superiority claim.
Hidden checks never enter model prompts or selection decisions. Stopping uses only public gates.
Development uses one manually planted training bug. Its lesson is validated against real child RTL and the complete gate suite.
Transfer is measured on an unseen failure family, not an unknown contract rule.
Token and wall costs exclude shared development; tokens are provider-reported and incomplete calls are not estimated.

limitations: Claude alone and raw retrieval passed 3/3 held-out designs. The graph passed 1/5 evaluated designs and accepted 1/3 trials within the same two-generation cap. No graph advantage was observed.
All arms passed 3/3 first-try sibling transfer probes; that does not imply the complete hidden suite passed.
Two graph trials emitted status flags from a lookahead counter and exhausted the repair budget. This is a negative result retained unchanged.
The later invariant-only sibling retrieval revision is not part of this experiment.
Three seeds and three fixed manual composite inputs. No statistical generalization or superiority claim.
